capabilityName: Place Account Hold Request (to confirmation screen)
goal: Signs on to Meridian Core as a supervisor operator, looks up a member by member number, opens the Place Account Hold action, fills in share, reason code and notes, and submits to reach the CONFIRM ACCOUNT HOLD review screen (banner: IRREVERSIBLE ACTION). It stops there without applying the hold, and returns the reviewed member, share, reason and notes for human approval. Returns a business outcome if no member matches the number supplied.
reason: Operator lacks supervisor rights for the hold function — supervisor_override_denied
guidance: Wording inferred, not observed. Re-run with a supervisor operator ID such as super1.
stepIntent: Submit the hold request details to reach the Confirm Account Hold review screen.
resolutionNote: rehearsal: supervisor reviewed, hold not applied
